Inspection Procedure B-1: Tone alarm: Ignition key reminder tone alarm function does not work 
normally.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
The ETACS-ECU operates the ignition key reminder 
tone alarm function, based on input signals from the 
following switches:
• Ignition switch (IG1)
• Key reminder switch
• Driver's door switch
If the function does not work normally, a defect on 
the relevant circuit or the ETACS-ECU may be 
suspected.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the key reminder switch
• Malfunction of the driver's door switch
• Malfunction of the ETACS-ECU
• Damaged harness wires or connectors
